# Psalm 61 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. On-stringed-instruments. Of-David.

**2** Hear my-cry, O-God; attend to-my-prayer.

**3** From-the-end of-the-earth I-call to-You when-my-heart faints; to-a-rock higher than-I lead-me.

**4** For You-have-been a-refuge for-me, a-tower of-strength from-the-face of-the-enemy.

**5** I-will-dwell in-Your-tent forever; I-will-take-refuge in-the-shelter of-Your-wings. Selah.

**6** For You, O-God, have-heard my-vows; You-have-given [me] the-heritage of-those-fearing Your-name.

**7** Days upon the-days of-the-king You-will-add; his-years [will be] as-generation and-generation.

**8** He-will-sit forever before God; steadfast-love and-truth appoint to-guard-him.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **61:3**: 'Rock higher than I' — the prayer for a vantage point above danger. The psalmist needs God's elevation to survive.

— EMET
